name: OpenMontage
description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files.
one_liner: Describe a video in plain words and an AI agent researches, scripts, generates clips, edits, and renders a finished piece, for a few dollars.
buyer: Small brands and solo creators who need a steady stream of short videos but can't afford an editor or a $200/month video SaaS.
business_use_cases: A DTC brand pumps out daily TikTok product films for the cost of a coffee each.
A course creator turns each written lesson into a narrated explainer video automatically.
A local agency offers 'ten branded shorts a month' to small clients at a price a human editor could never match.

money_ideas.idea: A hosted, no-code version for non-technical creators, billed per finished video or monthly.
A managed 'video content on autopilot' service for small businesses, priced as a monthly retainer.

steal_this: Offer real-estate agents a $99/month service: send a property's photos and details, get back a narrated listing video the next morning, produced with this.
